features.title: Engineered for Busy Store Fronts & Back Rooms
features.subtitle: No more hours spent keying delivery notes into spreadsheets. Skladnik replaces manual data entry with smart vision, proactive waste management, and tax readiness.
features.ocrBody: Hold your smartphone or tablet over any delivery slip or vendor invoice. Our specialized retail model detects SKU codes, descriptions, quantities, and prices in under 20 seconds.
features.wasteBody: Stop throwing spoiled goods into the trash. The First-Expired, First-Out engine calculates sell-by urgency and suggests timely promotions before items reach expiration.
features.expiresIn2: Expires in 2 days • Recommended: 30% Flash Sale
features.taxBody: Every delivery, write-off and stock movement is recorded with who posted it and when, and posted documents cannot be edited. E-shops get the monthly Annex No. 38 audit file for the NRA, built from posted sales and checked against the official schema.
features.accessBody: No expensive proprietary barcode guns or bulky Windows 7 POS terminals. Access your store inventory from any smartphone camera, iPad on the counter, or laptop back at home.
features.annexHint: Your posted history is kept from day one.

how.title: From Paper Bill to Live Inventory in 3 Steps
how.subtitle: Built specifically to save retail store owners and café managers hours of manual inventory ledger entry every morning.
how.step1Body: Point any smartphone camera at delivery paperwork, vendor bills, or upload PDF files directly from your suppliers.
how.step2Body: Our computer vision model isolates SKU codes, line quantities, unit tax, and dates into structured digital data with 99%+ accuracy.
how.step3Body: Stock updates the moment you post. Expiry alerts switch on, and every movement stays in the audit trail.

numbering.title: Numbering series
numbering.hint: Each new document takes the next free number of its series. Numbers are never reused, not even from cancelled documents. With “Reset each year”, the counter restarts at 1 on 1 January (Sofia time). Supplier invoices and delivery notes keep the number printed on them.

printTemplate.title: Print template
printTemplate.showCompanyDetails: Company name, ЕИК, VAT number and address at the top
printTemplate.footerPlaceholder: e.g. bank details or a note printed on every document

stockRules.windowsInvalid: Use whole days from 0 to {{max}}, each threshold fewer days than the one before.
stockRules.windowsHint: Used for the expiry board, the overview and the colour of expiry dates everywhere.
stockRules.rolesHint: Everyone else sells at the catalogue price. A price below cost needs a second confirmation, and every changed price is kept in the activity log with the catalogue price.
stockRules.rolesOwnerOnly: Only the owner can change who may edit prices.

activity.appendOnly: Entries can't be edited or deleted, not even by the owner.

reversal.hint: A posted document is never edited or deleted. If it was posted by mistake, reverse it: a linked opposite document undoes its stock movements, batch by batch.
reversal.explain: Reversing posts a linked opposite document today. Every stock movement of this document is undone at the same batch and cost, and this document is marked as reversed. It can't be undone, but you can enter the correct document afterwards.
reversal.returnsHint: Sending goods back to the supplier? Post the supplier's credit note instead. It is the tax document for the return and keeps the invoice in the VAT ledger.
reversal.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. wrong quantities, entered twice, wrong supplier
reversal.reversesOf: of {{date}}. Its stock movements are undone batch by batch, and neither document is in the VAT ledgers.

annex38.title: Annex 38 audit file
annex38.desc: The monthly audit file an e-shop sends to the NRA under Annex No. 38 of Ordinance Н-18. Pick the site and the month, fix anything the checks flag, then generate and archive the XML.
annex38.notRegistered: This site isn't registered as an e-shop.
annex38.scope: Annex 38 applies to online shops that use the alternative regime for card and bank payments (Art. 3(17) of Ordinance Н-18) instead of fiscal receipts. It lists every order paid in the month and every refund, and is filed from the 1st to the 15th of the following month. Shops that issue fiscal receipts don't file it.
annex38.correctionSubmitted: Version {{version}} was already marked as submitted. The new version is a correction and stays next to it in the archive.
annex38.checksBlocking: Fix the errors above before generating the file.
annex38.noOrders: No posted sales at this site in this month.
annex38.archiveEmpty: No Annex 38 files have been generated yet.
